ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: How do medicine and society interact? This course is intended to provide you with an informed and practical insight into the realities of Western biomedicine and medical education today. Designed for those interested in pursuing a degree in Medicine, this course will explore ethics in medicine, cultural interplays, medical school preparation and admissions, clinical praxis as well as highlight numerous current trends and issues within the medical field. For LLC students or by permission. For permission, please send email request to schuellk@illinois.edu.
